## Services

1. **Auto Detailing** — Full interior and exterior detailing including two-bucket hand wash, clay bar decontamination, carpet extraction, leather conditioning, machine polish, and paint sealant.
2. **Paint Correction** — Multi-stage machine polishing process that removes swirl marks, light scratches, water spots, and oxidation from the clear coat to restore true paint clarity and gloss.
3. **Ceramic Coating** — Professional-grade liquid polymer that chemically bonds to paint, creating a durable hydrophobic layer with UV protection and deep gloss lasting 2–5 years.
4. **Paint Protection Film (PPF)** — Custom-cut urethane film applied to high-impact surfaces (hood, bumper, mirrors) that absorbs rock chips and road debris before they reach the paint; self-healing top coat.
5. **Window Tinting** — High-quality film installation that blocks 99% of UV radiation, reduces interior heat, enhances privacy, and improves vehicle aesthetics; Oregon-legal options available.
6. **Vinyl Wraps** — Full or partial vehicle color change using cast vinyl film in matte, satin, gloss, chrome, or color-shift finishes; reversible without damaging factory paint.
7. **RV Detailing** — Specialized detailing for recreational vehicles including fiberglass oxidation removal, rubber roof membrane treatment, awning cleaning, slide-out seal conditioning, and interior deep cleaning.
8. **Boat Detailing** — Marine vessel detailing covering gelcoat oxidation removal, waterline stain treatment, hull machine polishing, marine wax/ceramic protection, and cockpit cleaning.
